nativeSelection.rule: The original BladeWave release checks the real Charging tag before transferring to NoCostB. The complete binding checks that tag only before normal exact-class activation, preserving the already paid source and allowing its tag to end on transfer.

nativeQualification: Normal native activation preserves GAS required/blocked tags, Blueprint CanActivateAbility, current weapon form, resource consumption and received attack context. Exact-class activation only uses an already granted spec.
limitations: Static package checks and executor fixtures do not establish in-game animation, damage or timing.
